Body.Content:
Data Explorer will be a one-stop shop for management of your Azure Cosmos DB data. Soon to be in preview, it will provide a rich and unified developer experience for inserting, querying, and managing data within the Azure portal and the Emulator.

Data Explorer will consolidate many of the database management tools in the Cosmos DB portal such as Document Explorer, Query Explorer, and Script Explorer, so that they'll all work without switching blades. Data Explorer Preview will soon be available in the Azure portal.

Learn more the features of Data Explorer.
